accepted_category: Compact genuine spectra for a finite group, indexed on a complete universe; ordinary thick closure under finite sums, cofibers, integer shifts and retracts.
accepted_results: Theorem A: both the actual-representation-sphere closure and the RO(G)-sphere closure equal the entire compact genuine category if and only if G is an elementary abelian 2-group, including the trivial group.

Theorem B: complete rational compact closure, factor by subgroup conjugacy class H, generated by integer shifts of rational orientation lines in the image of det(alpha^H) for alpha in RO(G). Actual and virtual generators give the same rational closure.

Proposition C: for any other finite group, the free orbit smashed with the mod-ell Moore spectrum is rationally zero but excluded from both integral closures whenever ell is odd and does not divide the group order.
Internal smash lemma: each closure is closed under smashing two of its own members; this does not imply tensor-ideal closure under arbitrary compact spectra.
Proposition D: G/H-plus lies in either integral closure exactly when H is normal and G/H is elementary abelian of exponent two, allowing the trivial quotient.
attribution: The equality criterion and rational closure are inherited results reconstructed and audited here. The Moore-spectrum obstruction, internal smash lemma and exact orbit membership are elementary audit consequences. No novelty or priority claim is made.
